# Name: # 8 MB flash layout for XIAO ESP32-S3 with OTA support.
#   otadata   - OTA bookkeeping (which partition to boot from)
#   storage   - FAT filesystem for local data
#   coredump  - Core dump for post-mortem crash analysis in the field
#   Both ota_0 and ota_1 are 1.5 MB. With TLS + MQTT + Wi-Fi provisioning
#   the firmware binary is typically 1.0-1.3 MB. 1.5 MB gives comfortable
#   headroom for future feature additions without repartitioning.
